旧金山的市政问题打 311：电话提供 160 多种语言的协助，从旧金山以外打 4: For city questions in San Francisco, call 311: help in over 160 languages by phone, or 415-701-2311 from outside SF; the SF311 app is available in Chinese.
长者服务不知道找谁，打所在县的老龄机构 AAA：全州信息线 800-510-20: Not sure where to start with senior services? Call your county's Area Agency on Aging: statewide 800-510-2020; San Francisco 415-355-3555, Alameda 510-577-1900, Santa Clara 408-350-3200, San Mateo 844-868-0938, Contra Costa 925-229-8434.
长者被骗钱、被忽视或虐待，打加州成人保护服务 1-833-401-0832，输入: If an elder is scammed out of money, neglected or abused, call California Adult Protective Services at 1-833-401-0832 and enter a ZIP code to reach the county, 24 hours.
旧金山 · 安老自助处（Self-Help for the Elderly）：总: San Francisco · Self-Help for the Elderly: main line (415) 677-7600. Adult day services staff speak Cantonese, Mandarin, Taishanese and other Chinese dialects, at 408 22nd Avenue, (415) 677-7556.
旧金山 · On Lok：PACE 全包式照护，把医疗、居家照护、交通和长者服务: San Francisco · On Lok: PACE, one program that includes medical care, home care, transportation and senior services; also a senior center and services such as meal delivery.
东湾 · Family Bridges 探访项目：给讲粤语或普通话、出门不便或少: East Bay · Family Bridges Visiting Program: for Cantonese- and Mandarin-speaking seniors 60+ who are homebound or isolated in Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Emeryville, Oakland or Piedmont; volunteers visit, call and help with light shopping, free; (510) 839-2022, Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–3 p.m.
旧金山、半岛和南湾 · NEMS 东北医疗服务：医疗、牙科、心理健康和验光配镜，: San Francisco, Peninsula and South Bay · NEMS (North East Medical Services): medical, dental, behavioral health and optometry, with clinics in San Francisco, Daly City, South San Francisco, San Mateo and San Jose; appointments 1-888-500-1886. Its MyChart self-scheduling videos come in Cantonese and Mandarin.
东湾 · Asian Health Services（亚洲健康服务）：1974: East Bay · Asian Health Services: founded in 1974, providing medical, dental and behavioral health care; administration (510) 735-3100; to become a patient, call Membership at (510) 986-6880 first; dental (510) 986-6888; its website is available in Chinese.
南湾 · AACI：San Jose 的健康中心正在收新病人，也有长者中心和心理: South Bay · AACI: its San Jose health center is accepting new patients, with a senior center and behavioral health services too; main line (408) 975-2730.

中文书、华埠历史和寻根: Chinese books, Chinatown history and family roots

奥克兰 · Oakland Public Library 亚洲分馆（Asian: Oakland · Oakland Public Library Asian Branch (388 Ninth Street, Suite 190, inside Pacific Renaissance Plaza): books in Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Vietnamese, and an English Asian Interest collection on Asian and Asian American history; closed Sundays; (510) 238-3400.

旧金山 · Chinese Culture Center（CCC）唐人街历史与艺: San Francisco · Chinese Culture Center (CCC) Chinatown History & Art Tour: booked on request for a date and time; individuals and private groups $55 per person, at least 4 people, about 90 minutes; it starts at the CCC Art Center and Design Store, 667 Grant Avenue.
东湾 · Alameda County Library 的 My China R: East Bay · My China Roots at Alameda County Library: a genealogy resource for Chinese ancestry, ancestral villages and surname origins, listed on the library’s eLibrary page.
